scientific_integrity: The mathematical claims are analytical; finite high-precision tests are auxiliary. The named underlying published map is credited. Independent review and publication-priority certification have not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The global absence covers prime period two for all positive alpha and 0<T<=2; existence, box uniqueness and repulsion cover only T>2 with alpha>=10. No statement is made about higher periods, global two-cycle uniqueness, noise, or hardware arithmetic.
title: Sharp prime-two exclusion and a saturated repelling cycle in a two-cell spiking map
